description: [[1], [true], [1]] under uniqueItems: true: jsonschema's own sort-then-compare-neighbours misses this real duplicate ([1] at index 0 and 2), since [true] sorts as tied with both under Python's own plain == without being equal() to either, so the two genuinely equal [1]s are never adjacent and never compared. Comparing every pair finds it regardless of position; the run finishes (on_error: continue) with the mismatch recorded.
